#!/usr/bin/env python
"""Unit tests for BALSAMIC/commands/base.py"""

import os
import sys
import unittest
from unittest import mock
import logging
import click
from click.testing import CliRunner

# Import modules to test
from BALSAMIC.commands.base import cli, LOG, LOG_LEVELS

class TestBALSAMICBaseCLI(unittest.TestCase):
    """Tests for BALSAMIC/commands/base.py CLI functionality"""

    def setUp(self):
        """Set up test fixtures, if any."""
        self.runner = CliRunner()

    def test_cli_version(self):
        """Test CLI version option works correctly"""
        result = self.runner.invoke(cli, ["--version"])
        self.assertEqual(result.exit_code, 0)

if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()
